OrderedSelection relates decls.zipIdx to table.entries. Only axis declarations may be skipped. Every emitted entry keeps the original declaration index, name, element type and ordered AxisSpec slots. Untyped tensor/linear classify as f32; typed tensor/linear admit f32/f64; linear bias is immaterial. The relation records the actual specs.find? result at the original declaration index, role equality and extent-list equality.
interfaces.entry_contract: For every t : table.declarations.Tensor, decls[(table.entry t).declaration]? = some original declaration. Classification and ordered slots refer to that declaration, not to t.val. The actual matching spec also has spec.declaration = entry.declaration.
interfaces.slots_contract: Forall2 preserves slot order and repeated axes. Each returned Axis has the corresponding declared AxisSpec UID and belongs to c.axes.
